thought.text: Now let me run an end-to-end transcription through the public web API to test operability.

reasoning_content:
Now let's do an end-to-end web workflow test: create session, upload file, transcribe, poll jobs, download. This is the strongest evidence. It uses the real code path. However, diarization may be needed. Let's try. Note HF token is placeholder, but whisper large-v3 is already downloaded, and speechbrain lang-id works. Diarization model (pyannote) failed download. If diarize is enabled (true by default in config), the transcription might fail. Let's see.

Let's do the test. Use test10sec.wav.

POST /api/session -> uuid. Then upload_file with X-Session-ID header. Then transcribe with body {"uuid": job_uuid}. Then poll /api/jobs.

Let's do it.

action.command: cd /workspace && SID=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8090/api/session | grep -o '"uuid":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4); echo "SESSION=$SID"; UP=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8090/api/upload_file -H "X-Session-ID: $SID" -F "file=@tests/data/test10sec.wav"); echo "UPLOAD=$UP"; JOB=$(echo "$UP" | grep -o '"uuid":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4); echo "JOB=$JOB"; echo "--- transcribe ---"; curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8090/api/transcribe -H "X-Session-ID: $SID" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"uuid\":\"$JOB\"}"; echo; echo "$SID" > /tmp/sid; echo "$JOB" > /tmp/job

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && SID=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8090/api/session | grep -o '\"uuid\":\"[^\"]*\"' | cut -d'\"' -f4); echo \"SESSION=$SID\"; UP=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8090/api/upload_file -H \"X-Session-ID: $SID\" -F \"file=@tests/data/test10sec.wav\"); echo \"UPLOAD=$UP\"; JOB=$(echo \"$UP\" | grep -o '\"uuid\":\"[^\"]*\"' | cut -d'\"' -f4); echo \"JOB=$JOB\"; echo \"--- transcribe ---\"; curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8090/api/transcribe -H \"X-Session-ID: $SID\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d \"{\\\"uuid\\\":\\\"$JOB\\\"}\"; echo; echo \"$SID\" > /tmp/sid; echo \"$JOB\" > /tmp/job", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Upload and transcribe test file via API"}
